title: Stop inferring the logical
notes: list end across a genuinely scrolling ancestor.
result: The frame traversal stops at vertical auto/scroll ancestors whose content exceeds the client height by more than the existing two-pixel slack. Ordinary frames, nonoverflowing auto containers and distinct inner cards retain their behavior. Immediate-list handling is unchanged; original private-screen acceptance is not claimed.
evidence: Two virtual-spacer regressions failed before the fix and seven controls passed. `pnpm --filter @syntopica/ui-quality exec vitest run tests/rules/listDanglingRule.scrolling.test.ts tests/cli.data-display.integration.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` passed 36 tests in two files. Package lint, type-check and build passed; independent review returned no findings. CodeGraph sync, formatting, doctor and diff checks passed.
